# A session shown in two windows has one size for its program, the last
# to resize set it (Rex's "Sized by another client"): a pane of another
# size says so at its top, and its click takes the size back. When the
# window that sized it goes, the one sized before it fits again. Run with
# --persist (the session lives in liberttyd).
expect-sized:no
other-window:50x10
wait:1.0
expect-sized:yes
type:stty size | sed s/^/A=/
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:A=10 50
fit-here:go
wait:1.0
expect-sized:no
type:stty size | sed s/^/B=/
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:B=
expect-not:B=10 50
# The other window sizes it again, then goes: back to this pane's.
other-window:60x12
wait:1.0
expect-sized:yes
other-window:close
wait:1.0
expect-sized:no
type:stty size | sed s/^/C=/
key:enter
wait:0.6
expect:C=
expect-not:C=12 60
